generator_cmd: printf %s 'free-over-strict decoy' | sha256sum | cut -c1-64 | xxd -r -p | base32 -w0 | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'  # 32 hash bytes: valid lowercase base32, decodes to binary junk
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z' | base32 -d | xxd -p | tr -d '\n'  # -> the raw sha256 digest (not printable text: stack_dec must return None)
